dedupe_keys.name: a comparative study on routing selection algorithms for dynamic planning of eons over c l bands

description: Arpanaei, Farhad and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. Three routing-selection algorithms are evaluated for dynamic planning over the C and L bands. The study compares bandwidth-blocking probability, quality of transmission and runtime, reporting the best performance for its min-max-frequency strategy. Coverage is the numerical planning experiment. Topology size, traffic distribution and software availability are unspecified in the abstract, so the result does not establish universal superiority. The model represents algorithm selection in optical network simulation. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
